items.title: Forty-Eight Hours to Bartz: Settlement Funding, Fairness-Hearing Stakes, and the Concord Cross-Motion
items.summary: With the second $300M installment due in 48 hours, the Bartz settlement approaches its most consequential week since preliminary approval. We map the inflection points across Bartz, Concord (Anthropic cross-MSJ filed April 22), and the broader docket.

items.title: Bartz Settlement Enters Its Most Consequential Week

items.title: Anthropic's Concord Cross-Motion: The Most Consequential Fair-Use Motion in AI Music Copyright
items.summary: Anthropic's cross-motion for summary judgment in Concord Music Group v. Anthropic, filed April 22, is the most consequential fair-use motion in any AI music copyright case to date. We unpack the doctrinal stakes for §107 analysis and the parallel publisher docket.

items.title: Bartz Fairness Hearing Rescheduled; Unsealed Objections Reach the Docket
items.summary: What was to be the day of reckoning for the largest copyright settlement in American history shifted under Judge Martínez-Olguín's April 8 order. We catalogue the unsealed objections — publisher favoritism, group-registration collapse, and statutory-damages adequacy — and what each may mean at the May 14 hearing.
